blocks.title: Data visualization
blocks.text: Data visualization data ko tasveeri shakal, graphs ya charts, mein dikhata hai ta ke andaaz, rujhan aur nukte jaldi samajh aayein.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ka kaunsa faida NAHI hai (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: (c) data ko zyada pecheeda banana; visualization data samajhna aasan banata hai.

items: Visualization adad ko tasveeron mein badalta hai jo andaaz aur rujhan dikhati hain.
